results.title: Why do traditional billing platforms fail for AI agent monetization?
results.content: Traditional billing systems are built for subscriptions or human-initiated transactions, not AI workloads. AI agents generate hundreds of sub-cent micro-actions per interaction, and percentage-based fees or minimum charges quickly make these transactions unprofitable. Agent-native platforms are required to meter, price, and settle these micro-activities in real time without destroying margins.
